classification.difficultyReason: Form a rectangle perimeter equation, combine like terms and solve for its unknown width.

inlines.text: The length of a rectangle is 6.7 cm. Its perimeter is 22.6 cm. Find the width of the rectangle.
(Hint: Draw a diagram. Label the width

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3: student-drawn rectangle requested in the hint
spec.description: An unshaded rectangle with its length labelled 6.7 cm and its width labelled x cm.
spec.mathematics: Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal; 22.6 = 2(6.7) + 2x, giving x = 4.6 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; no diagram is supplied in the student prompt.
